# Generative Process

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GenerativeProcess`](gmeow-GenerativeProcess.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GenerativeProcess>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A process that is itself musical content — phasing, stochastic distribution, verbal score, algorithmic rule set. The rule text is human-readable data; formal evaluation is delegated to a solver referenced by [`processFunction`](../properties/gmeow-processFunction.md) (Principles 4, 12). Realizations are linked by [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md).
